profile.summary: nassimnasibullah is a JavaScript developer with specialized contributions to localization within the `moment.js` library, focusing exclusively on Pashto language support. Their work demonstrates deep expertise in legacy JavaScript module systems, JSON-based configuration for internationalization, and cultural/linguistic accuracy in date/time formatting. While their contributions are limited to niche localization updates (no code changes), they show strong attention to detail, community collaboration, and an understanding of how JavaScript libraries handle localization. Their profile reflects a Junior-level developer with strong localization skills but limited exposure to modern JavaScript (ES6+) or broader ecosystem tools.
